pointing brass dish at the comms tower to search the wire

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Ceramic shield specs on the wire"

welding the final pressure seals onto the Little Dart with a tiny grin
entries.why: The Little Dart is at ninety-one percent and every weld brings me closer to the stars.
